subject.title: feat(workboard): bind cards to primary sessions

question: Should Workboard reserve a session key when it is placed on any bindable card, or only when a card becomes active through claim/running/review?
rationale: The branch currently uses both meanings: direct binding considers only running/review cards active, while claiming treats todo cards as conflicts. Maintainer intent is needed to choose the permanent lifecycle contract rather than preserving inconsistent rules.

options.title: Reserve on bindable cards
options.body: Reject duplicate session keys as soon as a non-blocked, non-done card receives one, then keep claim checks aligned with that reservation rule.

options.title: Reserve only on active cards
options.body: Allow provisional duplicates but select or require a deterministic winner at activation, keeping inactive cards from blocking all claims.

recommendation.title: Reserve on bindable cards
recommendation.body: Reject duplicate session keys as soon as a non-blocked, non-done card receives one, then keep claim checks aligned with that reservation rule.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current session-binding lifecycle proposal, though an area owner should confirm the final product contract.
